module rtlpp_01842  
 (
  input        clk,         
  input        reset,       
  input signed [7:0] x_in,  
  output signed [9:0] y_out,
  output reg clk2
 );
 
  parameter hold=0, sample=1;
  reg [1:0] state;
  reg [4:0]  count;
  reg signed [7:0]  x;      
  reg signed [25:0] i0, i1 , i2;  
  reg signed [25:0] i2d1, i2d2, c1, c0;       
  reg signed [25:0] c1d1, c1d2, c2;       
  reg signed [25:0] c2d1, c2d2, c3;       
      
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset)
  begin : FSM
    if (reset) begin         
      count <= 0; 
      state <= hold;
      clk2  <= 0; 
    end else begin 
      if (count == 31) begin
          count <= 0;
          state <= sample;
          clk2  <= 1; 
      end else begin
        count <= count + 1;
        state <= hold;
        clk2  <= 0;
      end
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) 
  begin : Int      
    if (reset) begin 
      x <= 0; i0 <= 0; i1 <= 0; i2 <= 0;
    end else begin
      x    <= x_in;
      i0   <= i0 + x;        
      i1   <= i1 + i0 ;        
      i2   <= i2 + i1 ;        
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) 
  begin : Comb                 
    if (reset) begin 
      c0 <= 0; c1 <= 0; c2 <= 0; c3 <= 0;
      i2d1 <= 0; i2d2 <= 0; c1d1 <= 0; c1d2 <= 0;
      c2d1 <= 0; c2d2 <= 0;
    end else if (state == sample) begin
      c0   <= i2;
      i2d1 <= c0;
      i2d2 <= i2d1;
      c1   <= c0 - i2d2;
      c1d1 <= c1;
      c1d2 <= c1d1;
      c2   <= c1  - c1d2;
      c2d1 <= c2;
      c2d2 <= c2d1;
      c3   <= c2  - c2d2;
    end
  end

  assign y_out = c3[25:16];

endmodule
